artworks.title: Diphyllodes chrysoptera (Magnificent Bird of Paradise)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two colorful birds perched on branches with fruit. The artwork depicts a pair of birds, one above the other, with rich plumage. The bird on top has orange and brown wings, while the bird below has a green breast with hints of blue and gold. The branches they sit upon have leaves and small, red fruit. Scroll-like curves are present, possibly representing the birds' tails. The background features a gradient of blue hues, suggesting an open sky. The style is reminiscent of John Gould's ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: Pyrrhula Erythrocephala (Redheaded Bullfinch)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image depicts a bird perched on a branch with sketched leaves. The bird has a rich color pattern of reddish-orange on its head and chest, dark gray wings, and a black face. The bird faces to the right, and the branch extends in both directions with symmetrical leaf designs. The background is a light beige color.

artworks.title: Epimachus speciosus (Sickle-billed Bird of Paradise)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of three birds with elongated tails resting among foliage. The painting depicts three vividly colored birds, each adorned with strikingly long and elegant tail feathers. The birds, perched on branches amidst lush green leaves, display a range of colors from deep blues and greens to earthy browns and shimmering blacks. The texture of their plumage is finely detailed, capturing the iridescent quality of the feathers. The background consists of trees and an abstract, softly rendered sky that provides a gentle, warm tone, highlighting the vividness of the birds. The scene is balanced, with the birds' delicate beaks and eyes adding to the realistic depiction. This is in the style of John Gould, known for his ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: Columba Leuconota (Snow Pigeon)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pigeon perched on a branch. The pigeon depicted is Columba Leuconota, showcasing its features. The pigeon has a sleek, grey and white body with brown and blue hues on its wings, standing on a branch with yellow feet. Its head is in profile view with red eyes and a dark, iridescent neck. The branch has fine bark detail, with some leaves in the background. The drawing is rendered realistically with a scientific illustration-like quality.

artworks.title: Enicurus Maculatus (Spotted Forktail)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird known as Enicurus maculatus. The image depicts a black and white bird standing on the ground. The bird has a predominantly black head and upper body with a white patch on the nape. The wings have white markings on a black background. The tail is elongated and forked with black and white bands. The bird has yellow legs and black talons. The drawing has a minimal composition focusing on the details of the bird's plumage and form.

artworks.title: Myiabeillia typica (Abeille's Hummingbird)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image contains a large white orchid flower with pink and yellow details at its center, surrounded by long green leaves. Two small birds with green iridescent feathers are perched on brown pods nearby. The color palette consists of various shades of green, white, pink, and brown. The orchid and leaves are in the upper right corner, while the birds are in the lower left corner on the pods.

artworks.title: Agyrtria bartletti (Bartlett's Emerald)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image depicts three hummingbirds interacting with pinkish-orange flowers. The birds have iridescent blue and green plumage. The background is soft and muted, highlighting the vibrant colors of the birds and flowers. The style of the painting resembles ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: Callipharus nigriventris (Black-bellied Hummingbird)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of four hummingbirds interacting with a flowering plant. The hummingbirds are depicted in vibrant hues of greens, browns, and whites, with iridescent feathers. The birds are gathered around a delicate branch with leaves and a white flower. The background transitions in subtle pastel shades, emphasizing the natural setting. The composition highlights the dynamic nature of the hummingbirds.

artworks.title: Damophila amabilis (Blue-breasted Hummingbird)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring three hummingbirds interacting with flowers. The birds are depicted with vibrant colors and iridescent shades of green, blue, red, and purple, hovering around yellow flowers with broad green leaves. The background has soft pastel hues, creating an ethereal atmosphere. The artwork is reminiscent of the detailed ornithological illustrations by John Gould.

artworks.title: Eucephala caerulea (Blue-chinned Sapphire)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of a pair of hummingbirds perched on a flowering branch. The painting features two vibrant hummingbirds with shimmering green and blue feathering, detailed with precision. One bird is perched on a pink flower bud, while the other is resting on a large, lush green leaf, both surrounded by an array of delicate white and yellow flowers and vibrant foliage. The background is a muted wash that subtly highlights the natural scene, allowing the intricate details of the birds and foliage to stand out. The botanical elements are depicted with attention to detail, giving a realistic yet artistic quality to the painting.

artworks.title: Helianthea osculans (Buff-tailed Star-Frontlet)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows two hummingbirds near a pink flower. The color palette includes pink, green, blue, and hints of warm brown. The hummingbirds are in flight near the flower, with one curving its body and the other sipping nectar. Foliage on the right side frames the birds and flower.

artworks.title: Lafresnaya flavicaudata (Buff-tailed Velvet-breast)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: A group of hummingbirds and orchid flowers are depicted against a soft, pale background. The hummingbirds display shades of green, blue, and orange, with dark feathers accentuating their bodies, while the flowers are pink and white with a yellow center. One hummingbird hovers to the left of the composition, facing an orchid with its wings outstretched. Two other birds are positioned on the right, nestled among long green leaves, with one perched on a stem and another appearing to fly towards a flower. The green leaves and stems of the orchid plants curve throughout the image.

artworks.title: Eriocnemis cupreiventris (Coppery-vented Puff-Leg)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of vibrant hummingbirds amidst tropical flowers and foliage. The scene depicts three hummingbirds with iridescent green plumage and bright blue tail feathers, perched on and around large green leaves. These leaves are part of a curling vine that also bears delicate flowers; one is pinkish-white while the other is bright orange. The background is a soft, pastel wash, highlighting the vivid colors of the birds and plants.

artworks.title: Eugenia imperatrix (Empress Hummingbird)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of hummingbirds interacting with a plant. The artwork features three vibrant hummingbirds near an exotic flower. The birds have iridescent green and blue plumage. One bird is in flight, while the others are perched on the flower and a leaf. The background shows a soft, pastel depiction of foliage.

artworks.title: Lophornis chalybeus (Festive Coquette)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of hummingbirds interacting with foliage and flowers. It features three vibrant hummingbirds with iridescent green and red plumage, engaged in flight around a flowering plant. The birds are depicted with intricate detail, showcasing their delicate and colorful feathers. They are arranged dynamically, capturing the motion of their wings and the grace of their hovering flight, while they interact with the flowers, which are pink with deep green foliage. The background consists of a subtle, soft blend of colors resembling a sky at sunrise or sunset, providing a serene backdrop for the subjects. The plant branches twist elegantly across the composition, and there is an air of delicate balance between all the elements in the painting. This is in the style of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Glaucis fraseri (Fraser's Barbed-throat)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows two hummingbirds near a group of large orchid flowers. The flowers are mostly white with yellow and pink accents, while the hummingbirds have iridescent green and brown feathers. The background is a soft gradient of pale blue, and there are large green leaves among the flowers. The orchids stand vertically with blooms pointing in various directions, and the hummingbirds are interacting with the flowers.

artworks.title: Eriocnemis vestitus (Glowing Puff-Leg)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows three hummingbirds around a pink flower on a cactus. The color palette includes shades of green, pink, yellow, and brown with hints of blue. The flower is positioned in the upper right corner, surrounded by the hummingbirds, and the cactus extends downwards from the flower.

artworks.title: Helianthea eos (Golden Star-frontlet)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of birds perched on flowery branches. The painting depicts several small birds with vivid iridescent plumage. They are interactively engaged with elongated bell-shaped flowers. The birds are portrayed meticulously, capturing their elegance and agile poses as they feed on the nectar of the flowers. The background is a soft gradient of pale blues and creams.

artworks.title: Diphogena aurora (Gould's Rainbow)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two hummingbirds near a flowering plant. The artwork depicts two detailed hummingbirds, one in flight with wings fully spread and the other perched, both focused on green and yellow flowers of a leafy plant. The birds have vivid iridescent green throats contrasted with rich, brownish-red bodies. The plant is delicately illustrated, with lush green leaves and slender branches adorned with buds and blooms. The background is a soft gradient of pastel hues, creating an airy and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Clytolaema aurescens (Banded Ruby or Gould's Ruby)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two hummingbirds amidst foliage and flowers. The hummingbirds are depicted in detail with shades of green, red, and iridescent hues. They are near blue and white flowers, on a moss-covered stone surrounded by green foliage with wide leaves. The background is a softly blended sky. The style is reminiscent of John Gould, known for ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: Eucephala smaragdocaerulea (Gould's Wood Nymph)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of three hummingbirds interacting with pink bell-shaped flowers on a vine. The painting shows two hummingbirds perched on a curved stem amidst green leaves, while a third hummingbird hovers in mid-air, feeding on the nectar of one of the blossoms. The hummingbirds have green and blue feathers contrasting with the pink flowers and pastel background. The style is reminiscent of John James Audubon, with detailed and realistic representation typical of classical ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: Chlorostilbona prasina (Puncheran's Emerald)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of two hummingbirds perched on a nest woven into a leafy branch. The painting features detailed portrayals of the birds and their nest. The background is softly shaded, and the leaves and tendrils of the plant frame the scene.

artworks.title: Discura longicauda (Racket-Tail)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: This is a painting of three hummingbirds perched and flying around flowering plants. The painting depicts two flying hummingbirds with vibrant green throats and long tails ending in dark, rounded feathers, alongside a third hummingbird perched calmly on the plant. The plants feature slender, elongated leaves and vivid pink flowers with long petals extending upwards. This is in style of John Gould. The background is softly washed in a light blue. The scene captures the elegance and agility of the hummingbirds amidst their natural habitat.

artworks.title: Spathura rufocaligata (Red-booted Racket-Tail)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. George Benjamin Green
artworks.description: The image shows three hummingbirds and a flowering plant with green leaves and a white blossom with a yellow center. The color palette includes vibrant greens and oranges on the birds, softly muted greens on the plant, and a pale background. Two hummingbirds are perched on a branch near the bottom center, while another hummingbird is in flight above them towards the top center, and a tendril extends from the plant toward the right side.
